# Configuration Reference

Default configuration for the Interlinked CLI harness.
Override in `.interlinked/guard-rules.json` (team) or `.interlinked/guard-rules.local.json` (personal).

## Diff-Aware Filtering

Controls which checks suppress pre-existing findings when editing files.

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | `false` | Master switch for diff-aware filtering |
| `missing_return_types` | `"baseline"` | Only report new findings via pre-edit baseline subtraction |
| `complexity` | `"edit_region"` | Only report complex functions in the edited region |
| `no_test_file` | `"new_files_only"` | Only fire on new file creation (Write), not edits |
| `undefined_env_vars` | `"edit_content"` | Only report env vars introduced by the edit |

## Structural Checks

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | `false` | enabled |
| `export_surface` | `true` | Detects breaking changes to exported symbols (renamed, removed, type-changed) |
| `import_resolution` | `true` | Validates all imports resolve to real files — catches typos and deleted modules |
| `duplicate_symbols` | `true` | Flags identical export names across files that could cause ambiguous imports |
| `co_dependency_staleness` | `true` | Warns when a file's dependencies were recently edited but this file wasn't updated |
| `import_cycles` | `true` | Detects circular import chains that can cause runtime issues |
| `interface_change_impact` | `true` | Identifies files affected when an interface or type definition changes |
| `test_proximity` | `true` | Suggests running related tests when editing source files |
| `smart_tsc` | `true` | Runs tsc only on the edited file when export surface didn't change (avoids full project rebuild) |
| `blast_radius` | `true` | Estimates how many files are affected by changes to a hub module |
| `stale_read_warning` | `true` | Warns when reading a file that was modified earlier in the session but not re-read |
| `sibling_awareness` | `true` | Suggests related files that may need updates when editing a module |
| `staleness_window_s` | `300` | Threshold setting |
| `blast_radius_threshold` | `5` | Threshold setting |
| `recently_failed` | `true` | Warns when editing a file that had check failures earlier in the session |
| `completion_tracking` | `true` | Tracks pending follow-up edits from export surface changes |
| `route_context` | `true` | Adds HTTP route/endpoint context when editing handler files |
| `redundant_reread` | `true` | Detects reading a file that was already read and hasn't changed |
| `dead_imports` | `true` | Detects imports that are no longer used after an edit |
| `completion_reminder_threshold` | `10` | Threshold setting |
| `dead_exports` | `true` | Detects exports with no importers in the project |
| `hallucinated_imports` | `true` | Catches imports of symbols that don't exist in the target module |
| `cross_package_imports` | `true` | Warns on imports that cross monorepo package boundaries incorrectly |
| `undefined_env_vars` | `true` | Flags process.env references not documented in .env.example |
| `layer_violations` | `false` | Enforces architectural layering rules (e.g., UI must not import from DB layer) |
| `impact_analysis` | `true` | Full dependency graph analysis showing breaking changes and affected downstream files |
| `impact_high_threshold` | `4` | Threshold setting |
| `test_first` | `true` | Nudge agent to write/run tests before editing source files |
| `cross_file_switch_discriminant` | `true` | Flags the same switch discriminant (.kind/.type/.tag) appearing in multiple files — usually a polymorphism opportunity |
| `single_implementation_interface` | `true` | Flags exported interfaces with exactly one implementor — possible premature abstraction |

## Metacoder (per-prompt overlay)

On every `UserPromptSubmit` the metacoder runs a peer of the coding agent (Opus 4.7 max-effort for Claude sessions, GPT-5.5 xhigh for Codex sessions) to emit a session-scoped overlay of guard rules. Both transports use the user's existing **Claude Code / Codex CLI subscription** — no API key required. Plan: [docs/design/metacoding-agent-plan.md](../design/metacoding-agent-plan.md).

**Toggle from the CLI:**

```
interlinked metacoder status        # show current state + recent audit
interlinked metacoder enable        # turn on (default)
interlinked metacoder disable --reason "burn rate"   # turn off, with audit
```

**Or hand-edit `.interlinked/guard-rules.local.json`:**

```json
{
  "metacoder": { "enabled": false }
}
```

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for the per-prompt metacoder |
| `timeout_ms` | `30000` | Metacoder LLM call timeout. Clamped at merge to keep < hook timeout (33000 ms). |
| `max_rules` | `20` | Hard cap on overlay rule count per emission |
| `max_pattern_length` | `200` | Per-pattern regex char cap (bounds ReDoS / compile cost) |
| `max_patterns_per_rule` | `10` | Patterns-per-rule cap |
| `max_addendum_chars` | `2000` | `system_prompt_addendum` length cap |

**Hook timeout coordination:** the generated hook waits 35000 ms (5 s buffer past the metacoder's internal timeout) so the harness can return a clean "metacoder timed out, allow" decision before the hook cold-falls back. Both `hook-entry.ts` (adapter path) and the generated `.mjs` (legacy path) honor this budget.

**Latency / cost:** 5–30 s per prompt, $0.05–$0.30 per prompt (Opus 4.7 max-effort). Fail-open: any subprocess failure (CLI not installed, subscription quota hit, timeout) skips the overlay and lets the prompt reach the agent against floor rules only.
